Our story

What I call you

Sakoon-e-Man, Shah-e-Man

Sakoon-e-ManPeace of my heart
Shah-e-ManKing of my heart
Mera MohtaramMy respected one
Mera ShehzadaMy prince

A letter for you

From Fazeeha, With All My Heart

Sakoon-e-man, shah-e-man, mera mohtaram, mera shehzada — aap ne mujhe pyaar karna sikhaya, aap ne mere dil ko jora. Aap ne mujhe duniya mein jannat dikha di. Aap sarapa sakoon hain.

Mujhe aap ke saath waqt guzarna bohat acha lagta hai. Aap ke saath jo waqt spend karti hoon, woh chahe kitna bhi zyada ho, kam hi lagta hai. Aap ko dekhti rahoon, dekhti rahoon — saari umer dekhti hi rahoon, itna pyaara lagta hai aap mujhe. Aapki aankhein, aapke hont, aapke cheeks, aapki neck — sab mujhe bohat bohat pasand hai. Bohat meethe se hain aap.

Jab aap ne mujhe pehli dafa hug kiya, mujhe itna pyaar diya ke mujhe lag raha tha main koi shehzadi hoon. Har baar aap mujhe princess treatment dete hain, itni efforts karte hain mere liye.

— aapki Fazeeha

Allah ka tohfa

Meri tahajjud ki duaon ka pyaara sa tohfa

Meri kisi neki ka sila hain aap. Meri tahajjud ki duaon ka pyaara sa tohfa — Allah ne mujhe aap se nawaza.

Aap mere pyaare se gugla hain, meethe se, mere sohne. Hamesha bohat mohabbat doongi main aapko, bohat izzat doongi — har lamha main aapka saath nibhaoon gi.

“I'm lucky to have you as a life partner.”
Fazeeha, for Hanzala

Nine months, nine frames

Our Little World

Ek pyaara sa khwab

Aur phir… ek chhoti si Hanzeeha

Fazeeha aur Hanzala ki ek Hanzeeha hogi — aur phir hamari life aur pyaari ho jayegi.

Ek aur pyaara sa dil, jo hamare sakoon ko aur gehra kar dega. Yeh khwab bhi aap ke saath hi khoobsurat hai, mere sohne.

Bas itna sa kehna hai

Bas Aap Yunhi Rahen

Mujhe aap se hamesha bohat mohabbat, izzat, care chahiye — aapki attention, aapka saara ka saara pyaar mera.

Itna rona aata hai mujhe, aur itna darr lagta hai — aap mere se naraaz na ho jayein, baat karna na chhor dein. Bas aap mujhe be-rukhi na dikhaya karein, na mere pe gussa howa karein, na khamosh howa karein — meri duniya udaas ho jati hai.

— sirf aapki

Hamara waada

Jo Hum Ne Ek Doosre Se Kaha

  • Hamesha saath. Kuch bhi ho jaye, kaise bhi haalaat hon, hum ek doosre ka saath nibhaayein ge.
  • Baatein kabhi band nahi. Hum kabhi baat karna band nahi karein ge.
  • Trust aur loyalty. Hamesha trust rakhein ge, hamesha loyal rahein ge.
  • Koi jhooth, koi raaz nahi. Ek doosre se kabhi na jhooth bolein ge, na kuch chhupayein ge.
  • Naraazgi mein bhi pyaar. Jo baat buri lage gi, woh bata dein ge ek doosre ko — khamoshi nahi, guftagu hogi.

Teen lafz, poori duniya
